prompt:
Create ONE high-fidelity MOBILE website first-viewport UI comp in a 9:16 portrait canvas for World Champion Taekwondo Washougal. Translate the attached locked desktop V-collar design faithfully; do not redesign the desktop visual world. The entire background is warm ivory/cream dobok fabric with a subtle realistic woven texture. It must unmistakably read as a polished mobile website UI, not a poster, blueprint, or fashion illustration.

Follow this exact top-to-bottom geometry and hierarchy:
[logo]     [name]     [menu]
-----------\   /------------
            \ /
            [ ]
         Washougal
        trains here.

1. HEADER ROW ABOVE THE V: a compact mobile header occupying approximately the top 9–11% of the canvas. Place the authentic circular World Champion Taekwondo school mark at left, “WCT Washougal” in bold condensed dark navy type near center/left, and a clear three-line hamburger menu at right. The header itself is separate from the V and sits above it on ivory weave.
2. Directly beneath the header, a thin horizontal navy/near-black bar spans the width and folds inward into a SMALL phone-scaled dobok collar V. The collar arms slope down symmetrically and meet at a point around 30–34% canvas height. Keep the V much smaller and shallower than the desktop version so it does not dominate the phone. The collar is deep ink navy, almost black, with fabric texture and one restrained line of fine gold running stitch near its inner edge. The gold must look like real sewn thread, subtle and just visible—not neon, not chunky yellow dashes, and no extra stitching scattered around the page.
3. AT THE EXACT POINT OF THE V, place one small, clean square photo tile, approximately 24–28% of canvas width. Use the attached v4 photo and crop/art-direct it so ALL THREE students are visibly present inside the square, even though compact. The square is simply the collar point: no blue border, no decorative frame, no double border, no floating card treatment.
4. BELOW THE V AND PHOTO, center a strong mobile headline with exact text “Washougal trains here.” Use large bold condensed dark navy typography over two lines, with ample ivory space. Directly below, exact support copy: “Master Chulan Kim. A safe, positive school for families.” in smaller dark navy type over two or three balanced lines.
5. Below the support copy, place a prominent red rank-tape CTA with small authentic fabric/notched tape ends and exact white uppercase text “RESERVE YOUR FIRST CLASS”. It should be clearly tappable and website-like. Beneath it, place the secondary text link “MEET MASTER KIM” in blue/navy, optionally with a restrained right arrow.

Preserve the desktop’s calm authority, tactile dobok construction, ivory/navy/red palette, bold condensed editorial typography, and subtle tailoring details. Keep generous spacing and a clear single-column mobile hierarchy. Ensure all UI text is spelled exactly and remains legible. No $40 anywhere. No dashed blueprint grid. No blue box around the photo. No extra image borders. No oversized V. No navigation links besides the hamburger. No invented badges, cards, bottom feature row, or additional sections. Do not omit any of the three students. The first viewport should end with comfortable ivory space after “MEET MASTER KIM”.
